name: Defluff
description: Reverse the AI in corporate email. For every message Defluff guesses what prompt the sender gave an LLM, classifies urgency (ACTIONABLE / RESPONSE-NEEDED / FYI / NOISE), and extracts 3–5 bullets of real intent. Handles single emails, threads, and batch triage. Detects invoice fraud / BEC, phishing, fake recruiters, fake interviews, conference scams, and crypto pitches with specifically named red flags — lookalike domains, fake forwarded approvals, urgency + payment redirects.
longDescription:
Ships **1 skill**, `defluff` (Reverse the AI in corporate email).

Installs with `claude plugin install defluff@claude-community` from `FinAegis/defluff` (`apps/claude-skill`).

A Claude Code plugin that extracts the actual intent of an email into 3–5 bullets, using the same fixed wording as the browser extension and Outlook add-in. Ships through the FinAegis marketplace at the repo root.
